title: Five-Word Discrete Vocabulary Joint BiGAN Smoke (Legacy Prior Cohort)
intuition: Historical pre-refactor comparison cohort of `five_word_joint_smoke` retained under its original prior ownership contract so legacy baselines stay strictly separated from `recipe_owned_v1` tasks. Trains a joint BiGAN (generator, encoder, joint critic) with exactly 5 learned 2D particles on a 5-word discrete vocabulary ('apple', 'grape', 'lemon', 'melon', 'berry'). Must generate all 5 words cleanly and reconstruct every word with >= 0.90 token confidence.
failure_mode: Two words collide onto one particle or the encoder fails to invert the generator's discrete assignments, breaking exact reconstruction.
protocol_notes: Retained legacy diagnostic cohort for `five_word_joint_smoke` before the recipe-owned prior refactor; cannot substitute for current ordinary qualification cells.
